item.description:
What's New in Version 0.1.0

  • First public release of Echo
  • Local AI transcription with whisper.cpp and Parakeet
  • Cloud transcription via Deepgram, Groq, ElevenLabs, Gemini, Mistral
  • Adaptive Awareness profiles for context-aware transcription
  • AI-powered text enhancement and formatting
  • Custom dictionary and word replacements
  • Screen capture context for smarter transcription
  • Global hotkey recording
  • Full light and dark mode support
